info.title: Panopticam — Decompiled Blueprint API
info.description: Clean-room OpenAPI 3.1 contract extracted by VaultWares Decompile from https://ovh-panopticam.tail1764b8.ts.net

get.description: Live rooms worth cutting to right now, best first, with the reasons (director.py).

schema.title: Response Director Picks Api Director Get

post.description: The PC's live taste head (vision/moments_embed.py: rated minutes cut into live-like windows).

schema.title: Response Taste Head Api Vision Taste Post

get.description: Live taste (taste.py): the head in force and, with ``limit``, the rooms that score highest now.

schema.title: Response Taste Status Api Taste Get

get.description: Minutes kept when something was happening (moments.py), newest first.

schema.title: Response Moments List Api Moments Get

get.description:
Moments most like this one by picture and sound (the PC's EmbeddingGemma 2 vectors), other rooms
unless ``same_room``. ``ready`` false: this minute has no vector yet (the PC embeds hourly).

schema.title: Response Moment Similar Api Moments  Mid  Similar Get

get.description: ``video.mp4`` (the minute, with sound) or ``sprite.jpg`` (8 frames across it).

schema.title: Response Moment Keep Api Moments  Mid  Keep Post

post.description: The operator's verdict (the page, or the folders they sort the PC copies into).

schema.title: Response Moment Rate Api Moments  Mid  Rate Post

post.description: How lively the PC found the minute (vision/moment_quality.py).

schema.title: Response Moment Life Api Vision Moments  Mid  Life Post

post.description:
The PC's EmbeddingGemma 2 vectors (vision/moments_embed.py), many per call; answers the ids this
server still has (the PC stops sending the others).

schema.title: Response Moment Vecs Api Vision Moments Vecs Post
Response Moment Delete Api Moments  Mid  Delete

get.description:
The live index, filtered. ``keys`` (comma-separated site:room) narrows it to those
rooms; ``vq`` (a description) or ``like`` (a room key) ranks by what rooms look like.

post.description: Make the database backup now (before a risky change); the PC takes it within 30 min.

schema.title: Response Backup Now Api Backup Post

get.description:
Where the API's memory is (estimated per attribute of the long-lived objects).
``gc_types``: also the most common GC-tracked object types (a full GC's worth of work: ~0.5 s).

schema.title: Response Debug Heap Api Debug Heap Get
Response Stills Status Api Stills Get

schema.title: Response Dataset Back Api Datasets  File  Back Post
Response Vision Gallery Api Vision Gallery Post

post.description: The workstation copied these waiting archives to its disk: free the VPS (datasets.offload).

schema.title: Response Vision Datasets Offloaded Api Vision Datasets Offloaded Post

post.description: Archives that exist only on the workstation, to be ingested like the others (datasets.register_local).

schema.title: Response Vision Datasets Local Api Vision Datasets Local Post

Rooms where something happens most often: ``state:nude``, ``action:4``, ...
Out of the rooms with at least ``min_n`` readings (states) or clips (actions).

schema.title: Response Traits Top Api Traits Top Get

get.description:
How good were the "Next 3 h" chances? Logged forecasts whose window has closed,
against the sessions that followed (1-hour cache).

Response Room Stream Api Rooms  Site   Room  Stream Get

delete.description:
Delete a finished recording: the workstation sends the file (and its sidecar)
to its Recycle Bin, and it leaves the list. A file already gone just leaves the list.

schema.title: Response Delete Recording Api Recordings  Job Id  File Delete

get.description: Play a finished recording: proxied from the workstation (remuxed to MP4 there), Range-aware.

schema.title: Response Stop Recording Api Recordings  Job Id  Delete
Response List Rules Api Rules Get
Response Create Rule Api Rules Post
Response Update Rule Api Rules  Rule Id  Put
Response Delete Rule Api Rules  Rule Id  Delete

post.description: Workstation jobs reach the operator through here (not from the home IP): email, else Telegram.

schema.title: Response Vision Notify Api Vision Notify Post

post.description: One test message to the configured address (Settings or a curl on the tailnet).

schema.title: Response Mail Test Api Mail Test Post
Response Vision Work Api Vision Work Get
Response Vision Results Api Vision Results Post

get.description: Sampled clips for the worker: a 4-frame sprite (JPEG) and the sound (Ogg/Opus), base64.

schema.title: Response Vision Clips Api Vision Clips Get
Response Vision Clip Results Api Vision Clip Results Post

get.description: Clips for the tower's Whisper (speech.py): key + the room's latest sound, base64.

schema.title: Response Speech Work Api Speech Work Get
Response Speech Results Api Speech Results Post

get.description:
What rooms said (Whisper transcripts of clips with clear speech, 7 days), newest first.
``q``: every word must appear (the last one as a prefix); ``live``: rooms on air now only.
Languages of the live rooms (sticky labels, verdicts applied), most rooms first.

schema.title: Response Speech Langs Api Speech Langs Get

get.description: Live rooms per value of a label family (hair, lang, place), most first.

schema.title: Response Label Counts Api Labels Counts Get

post.description: The operator's say on a label: yes (lock for good), no (never again), clear.

schema.title: Response Label Verdict Api Labels Post

get.description:
A room's current thumbnail, fetched from OVH for the workstation worker.

Operator rule (28 Sep 2026): nothing automated may reach the sites from the
workstation's home IP — it interferes with the operator's own sessions. The
worker gets its pixels here instead; only results travel back.

schema.title: Response Vision Thumb Api Vision Thumb Get

get.description: Operator verdicts for the workstation's Atlas to apply (merge / keep apart).

schema.title: Response Vision Links Api Vision Links Get

get.description: Cross-site pairs whose faces look alike, for a quick same / not verdict.

schema.title: Response Room Identity Api Rooms  Site   Room  Identity Get

post.description:
Who is this? (6 Oct 2026): the operator drops a photo; the workstation reads its faces
(the face models live there) and this searches every room's face, persona and gallery tie.

schema.title: Response Whois Gallery Photo Api Whois Gallery  Name  Photo Get

get.description: Gallery identities that look like one person, best first (two-people verdicts left out).

schema.title: Response Merge Candidates Api Merges Get

post.description:
Merge (or rename) on the PC, then the VPS side. Done within ~45 s: the result. Else 202
``{"queued": true, "job": …}``, and ``/api/merges/jobs/<job>`` says when it's finished.

schema.title: Response Merge Identities Api Merges Post
Response Merge Job Api Merges Jobs  Job  Get
Response Merge Two People Api Merges Two People Post
Response Merge Undo Api Merges Undo Post
Response Merge History Api Merges History Get

post.description: Merge many pairs at once (they wait for the gallery lock together); the record is reviewed later.

schema.title: Response Merge Batch Api Merges Batch Post
Response Merge Batches Api Merges Batches Get

post.description:
A batch cut short (a worker or server restart): every merge the PC did since the batch began is
applied here (idempotent) and filed in the record; answers the pairs still to do (14 Oct 2026).

schema.title: Response Merge Reconcile Api Merges Reconcile Post

post.description: The operator looked at one batch merge: "looks right" (or the Undo the page did).

schema.title: Response Merge Batch Reviewed Api Merges Batches Reviewed Post

Response Create Action Api Actions Post
Response Update Action Api Actions  Aid  Put
Response Delete Action Api Actions  Aid  Delete
Response Pin Action Api Actions  Aid  Pinned Put

get.description: Live rooms ranked by how sure the action's head is, with their room rows.

schema.title: Response Action Rooms Api Actions  Aid  Rooms Get
Response Action Review Api Actions  Aid  Review Get
Response Label Action Api Actions  Aid  Labels Post

get.description:
The room's latest sample: ``sprite.jpg`` (4 frames side by side) or ``sound.ogg``;
its latest long clip: ``long.mp4`` (a minute, sound included) or ``long.jpg``.

Leaderboards from the sessions history: most hours live, most sessions,
highest peak, best average audience — over a day, a week, or everything.

People rather than rooms: Atlas personas with every room they were seen in.

``scope``: ``multi`` (two or more rooms — the interesting ones), ``named``
(verified by the gallery or named by you), ``all``.

schema.title: Response Performer Api Performers  Pid  Get
Response Rename Performer Api Performers  Pid  Put

post.description: Not this person: take one room out of a persona (the Atlas splits it on its next pull).

schema.title: Response Drop From Performer Api Performers  Pid  Drop Post
Response Set Link Api Links Put
Response Get Kv Api Kv  K  Get
Response Put Kv Api Kv  K  Put

get.description:
The room's chat as server-sent events: ``backlog`` (what it said lately) first, then
one ``chat`` event per message / tip / notice. Looking at a room is what follows it.
Rooms by tokens tipped (Statbate-style), from the chats we follow, and the biggest tippers.

schema.title: Response Chat Top Api Chat Top Get
Response Chat Tips Api Chat  Site   Room  Tips Get
